text: APPROVE: both extractions keep the original conditions and their short-circuit order (the second only splits an `&&` into an outer `if` plus a guard inside the helper), every helper parameter is used, and removing two nested `if`/`&&` constructs from the method drops its complexity by well over the 2 points needed. One assumption I couldn't check from the diff alone is that `sourceTextRefs` is a `List<SourceTextRef>`.
